sentences.text:
For reference, relevant para-3 of the above affidavit reads as under:-
" That the present writ petition has been rendered infructuous in view of the fact that the prayer of the petitioner to decide the application submitted u/s 28A of the Land Acquisition Act dated 29.09.2018 received in the office of answering respondent on 04.10.2018 and the same has been rejected being time barred on 29.11.2019.
Therefore, the prayer of the petitioner is already fulfilled and the present writ petition has become infructuous.

A copy of the report submitted by Kanogone to Land Acquisition Officer is also signed by Land Acquisition Officer dated 29.11.2019 is attached herewith as Annexure R-1. "
3.
In view of the above, present petition is disposed off as having rendered infructuous.
Needless to say that in case the petitioner feels aggrieved, he may move appropriate application for recalling of this order and same shall be considered in accordance with law.
